title: Actual E5 native publication and retrieval on N37
question: Do all selected E5 context variants publish and retrieve under the corrected N37 native guard?
method: Run the three managed actual E5 cases on a private PostgreSQL installation of frozen N37. Separately verify a newly prepared and admitted Standard application on the registered N37 stage.
commands: uv run ci db check --target deployment --release RELEASE --json
uv run ci release check --target deployment --release RELEASE --native-proof --json
conclusion: The frame, referent and discourse-neighbor E5 cases passed native publication and retrieval on private N37. The exact newly admitted Standard release also passed both N37 stage checks.
